applies_why: This judge text decides the Isaiah 7:14 link by separating the challenger's wording answer from the defender's prophetic-application answer instead of weighing the opposing chains by footing.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: The phrase 'weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse' has two readings: compare the whole opposing chains by support, or split the link into wording and application and assess separate answers; I weigh the former as required and the latter as what the judge did.
why: The judge says UNDERDETERMINED because the challenger answered wording and the defender answered application, which is a verse-by-verse split rather than the chain-against-chain footing comparison K-C requires.
